facts.fact: According to EMARKETER, the percentage of the US population watching live sports rose slightly from 46.9% in 2018 to 47.6% in 2024.
facts.quote: the percentage of the population watching live sports has remained steady—rising only slightly from 46.9% in 2018 to 47.6% in 2024.

facts.fact: The vendor reports there were 105.3 million digital live sports viewers in 2024.
facts.quote: In 2024 alone, there were 105.3 million digital live sports viewers, and that number is projected to hit 127.4 million by 2027.

facts.fact: Netflix took its first steps into live sports with an NFL game for Christmas 2024 and plans to air WWE content in 2025.
facts.quote: Netflix, a newcomer to live sports, took its first steps with an NFL game for Christmas 2024 and plans to air WWE content in 2025.

facts.fact: YouTube TV houses the NFL's Sunday Ticket.
facts.quote: Notably, YouTube TV now houses the NFL’s Sunday Ticket, solidifying its place in the live sports ecosystem
